The file server is the grey box under the desk (nas.example.com, 192.0.2.10). It holds the family photos, scanned documents and backups.

Getting in

  1. On any computer at home, open a browser and go to https://nas.example.com.
  2. Log in with the "File server" entry from the passwords appendix.
  3. The photos are under Shared > Photos.

Copying everything off

Plug an external drive into the front USB port, then use the file manager's Copy to on the Shared folder. Expect a few hours for the photos.
